summary: Built the pure §3 ruins. New code: packages/content/src/ruins (the constants and the zod ruinRulesSchema/validateRuinRules, with a test) and packages/simulation/src/ruins (seeded sequence and navigation generation, clueFor, reportPresence/openRuin/answerRuin with sources-unlocked and gold-awarded events, and per-(player, ruin) lockouts). Tests: puzzles.test.ts covers generation, no-leak and timing over 500 seeds with evaluators written in the test file. operations.test.ts has the scripted solving and refusal cases for both kinds. determinism.test.ts covers hash coverage and a seeded session replay. Also added docs/ruins.md and one ./ruins subpath export each in packages/simulation/package.json and packages/content/package.json. After npm ci, I ran npm run typecheck, npm run test:unit (28 files, 560 tests), npm run test:integration (6 files, 36 tests) and npm run build (smoke passed). All exited 0. I also loaded both new subpaths from dist/ by hand with node. Measured: the best hint-ignoring sequence guesser averages about 178 s (10th percentile 30 s), and the shortest-first navigation guesser averages about 2222 s (10th percentile 303 s).
open_assumptions: Presence is reported through reportPresence(playerId, island|null, inDuel); a duel or any other island closes the session. The caller calls it when mooring or casting off and when reserveDuel starts.

A malformed attempt (wrong kind or length, repeated or unknown symbol, 0 or more than 16 moves) is refused as invalid-request with no lockout. Every well-formed non-solution counts as a wrong answer and locks the player out.
Opening a ruin is allowed during a lockout and after solving (the clue is shown). Answering after solving is refused as already-solved.
Symbol set: sun, moon, tide, storm, anchor, skull. Tablets are always shown in this fixed order, so the layout is independent of the answer.
The ruins draw from their own stream: the match seed XOR 0x5255494e.
untested: scripts/smoke-build.ts does not list the new @pirate-sea-race/*/ruins subpaths (the script is outside my owned paths). I loaded them from dist/ by hand only, and no check does it.
Human reading time per clue: the 20–40 s target is covered only by the scripted reader, which solves within 2 ticks, and the guesser bounds.
verify_yourself: Read a few generated sequence clues through tabletText (for example the first sequence ruins in puzzles.test.ts) and check a person really deduces them in seconds. Hints like 'Skull does not come first' on an absent symbol are true but could slow a human reader.
